def solve(M,v):
 A=[row[:] + [vi] for row,vi in zip(M,v)]
 m=len(A)
 for i in range(m):
  piv=A[i][i]
  for j in range(i,m+1): A[i][j]/=piv
  for k in range(m):
   if k==i: continue

res=sum((ypred(x)-y)**2 for x,y in zip(xs,ys))

for w in ['A3','B3','C3','D3','E3','F3','G3','H3']:

 A=c; B=b; C=a-y
 disc=B*B-4*A*C
 roots=[(-B+math.sqrt(disc))/(2*A),(-B-math.sqrt(disc))/(2*A)]
